title: Hailstorm
description: At the end of your turn, if you have [gold]Frost[/gold], deal [blue]6[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
smart_description: At the end of your turn, if you have [gold]Frost[/gold], deal [blue]6[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
notes: Activates only if the owner has at least 1 Frost Orb at the end of their turn. Deals 6 damage to all enemies in combat.
